label: PF Backlog 405
title: PFSSOT-P12: optimization (only after correctness)
body: P12 optimization. RECONCILED: worker matching / capacity-aware scheduling / path-overlap contention / elastic-wave parallelism already implemented in core/scheduler.py + core/capacity.py; worker affinity/resource constraints rehomed to WorkerGrid (ADR-0002/0003). Remaining PF-side optimization split into P12a (rate budgeting) + P12b (queue fairness).

acceptance_criteria: Objective achieved: PFSSOT-P12: optimization (only after correctness)
approach: After SSOT/claim/lease correctness: add worker matching + capacity-aware scheduling + resource constraints + smarter parallelism + queue optimization + affinity + advanced contention detection.
verification: affinity + contention detection produce deterministic plans
summary: Reconciled: mostly already-implemented/rehomed; remaining = P12a + P12b.

api_impact.reason: no API surface declared in backend_capability

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/scheduler.py and the existing worker-queue APIs (/api/v1/workers/queue, /capacity, /metrics). Split into two independent sub-tracks: P12a rate budgeting - add a token-bucket / concurrency-budget abstraction consumed by the scheduler before dispatch, persisted via core/worker.py capacity state; P12b queue fairness - add weighted/fair queue ordering (e.g., round-robin per project or aging boost) inside the existing queue selector, configurable via config/engineering-workers.json. Reuse capacity.py and worker.py; no new component. Gate all work behind the existing WorkerGrid Stage 3 readiness trigger.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES pfssot-p11-adapters - adapters must be in done state.
RELATED BI-PF-0416 (defect on schedule/next) should be fixed first - fairness on a selector that returns executed items is wasted work.
RELATED BI-PF-0422 (dedup guard) shares queue-touching code.
conflict_findings: BI-PF-0416 modifies core/scheduler.py next_eligible - direct conflict; land 0416 before starting 0374.
BI-PF-0422 touches assignments/dedup on the same queue path - coordinate merge order.
WorkerGrid Stage 3 (external) may change capacity model - align before persisting budget state.
duplication_findings: Worker matching / capacity-aware scheduling / path-overlap contention / elastic-wave parallelism already implemented in core/scheduler.py + core/capacity.py - do NOT rebuild (body confirms RECONCILED).
Worker affinity/resource constraints rehomed to WorkerGrid - out of PF scope.
BI-PF-0422 (assignments view + dedup guard) and BI-PF-0416 (defect) touch the same schedule/queue path - sequence carefully.
analysis.rationale: Reuse-first: scheduler + capacity infrastructure already exists; P12a/P12b are additive policy layers (EXTEND). Blocked on correctness (BI-PF-0416) and WorkerGrid Stage 3.
assumptions: WorkerGrid Stage 3 will be declared ready before implementation starts.
config/engineering-workers.json is the canonical place for scheduler tuning knobs.
core/capacity.py exposes enough capacity signal for budget computation.
risks: Premature optimization before correctness (BI-PF-0416) would compound rework.
Fair-queue policy choice (round-robin vs weighted vs aging) may not fit all tenants - needs policy decision.
Rate budgets need persistent counters; in-memory is lossy across restarts.
WorkerGrid Stage 3 timing unknown - item may sit long and code may drift.
evidence: Body explicitly states worker matching/capacity/contention/elastic-wave already implemented - RECONCILED.
core/worker.py + core/capacity.py listed as existing code.
missing_info: Rate budget scope: per-worker, per-project, or per-tenant?
